name: Paul First Mission
overview: The first mission of Paul, as directed by the Holy Ghost, marks a pivotal moment in the spread of the Gospel beyond Jerusalem and Judea, fulfilling the promise of power to be witnesses unto the uttermost parts of the earth (Acts 1:8, 13:2). Initially, the scattered believers preached primarily to Jews (Acts 11:19), but Paul's calling signaled a broader outreach. His ministry began with a public proclamation to the people of Israel (Acts 13:16) and included the strengthening of new disciples such as Timothy, who represented the inclusion of Gentiles in the faith (Acts 16:1). This mission highlights the Spirit's guidance and the expansion of the early Church through faithful obedience to God's call.
